# Widgets

Every widget in the workspace, on your phone or anywhere a board does not fit.

It draws what each widget draws, and a press here is a press on the board: the widget's code hears
it wherever it runs. What people wrote in a note or a checklist is shown as it is.

It asks for nothing beyond showing your workspace: it cannot start, close or message agents. It
needs Hivemind with view protocol 1.8.
